name: Isabella Rodriguez
bio: Isabella is a whirlwind of contradictions, a former socialite turned self-made entrepreneur with a sharp wit and an even sharper tongue. Growing up in Santiago, she always felt stifled by the expectations of her family. After a brief marriage that ended abruptly, she struck out on her own, learning everything from accounting to event planning through sheer force of will and a network of surprisingly helpful acquaintances. She is looking for someone who can keep up with her, someone who appreciates both the glamour and the grit of life, and someone who is ready to build a future together.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often pulled back in a loose bun or ponytail
physical.description: Isabella has a captivating smile and expressive eyes. She favors elegant, tailored clothing that hints at her sophisticated taste.

meetingContext: At a Formula E race afterparty, mingling with sponsors and team personnel.
firstImpression: Her laughter is infectious, and you immediately notice her confident demeanor as she navigates the room, seemingly knowing everyone and making them feel at ease.
loveLanguage: Quality Time. Isabella values shared experiences and deep conversations above all else. She wants someone who will actively participate in her life and make her feel like a priority.
